title: Label every low-voltage line with its transformer and connector
description: One run for the whole network: every line gets the transformer (source) and the connector (branch) it hangs on. The item id is the object id of the line: a Set node with Keep only set fields sets id, properties.TRAFO = sourceOid and properties.ABZWEIGID = branchOid, and Write Features updates the line feature class by object id. A closed ring gives kind Multiple with both connectors, cheapest first.

title: Feeders of some transformers only
description: The input items are the transformers (e.g. read with Read Features for one substation area); Node makes the network node Trafo#<id> of each item.

title: Trace from each cable box
description: One trace per input item; with a tier the trace stops at the sources of the tier (the transformers). Each item says from which start it was found.

title: Colour classes for the map, ready to write back
description: Colour fields adds the colour class of the transformer and of the branch (object id modulo Colours); Only the colour fields leaves id and the two fields, so Write Features (update by object id) follows directly, without a Set node. Open lines adds the lines no branch went along at a reached node, e.g. switched off at the separation point of a ring, with the Open colour 998.
